title: Airport/school/mallworld
content: I’m usually running around trying to get to class in a big mall/ university looking building- there are way too many staircases and floors but I seem to be able to get around pretty fast.. sometimes as I’m rushing I decide to randomly step outside and catch a plane from the airplane bus stop, go somewhere for the day ..but I know I’m not supposed to, it’s like I work at the airport and am abusing the system and taking free flights to escape for the day.. and then am rushing to get back before my “shifts over”..even though I’m also just at school/ university (it alternates from middle school to uni). It’s usually California I go to (from Toronto); when arriving the runway/ highway turns into a roller coaster and there’s like splashes of water as if it’s a water based coaster..the plane is not a plane anymore, it’s a roller coaster cart.. and this all feels normal not abrupt or weird at all. This is all I can articulate right now and am getting overwhelmed with how much I can’t really put into words. Can anyone relate to any of this lol?
